notes.title: Dark Light: Survivor Development Update June 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Sorry it's been a while since our last update. We've been deep in the trenches working non stop to get the demo ready, aiming for late August. The truth is the project turned out way bigger than we expected, which pushed back both our updates and marketing a bit. But good news, we’ve made real progress and we’re excited to finally share what’s been going on.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="LB3rz_agqeI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]If you want regular behind the scenes peeks, make sure to follow us on X [url="https://x.com/MirariRelics"]@MirariRelics.[/url] Link in the description. We post updates there almost every week. So what’s new The armor system is now fully in. You’ll be able to find different armor types in game, each with its own rarity and randomly rolled stats. On the weapon side, both melee and ranged systems are up and running.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/3f1e3e3e9b8210384f2ac8fc92df3510339337b7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/454328a69d13ca76f0c0d536f561dd1c5d185103.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For melee weapons, we’ve added a rune socket system. You can equip runes you find during your run to boost stats, and some even grant effects like triggering an ice spike that deals frost damage. We’re also working on a Rune Word system. Combine specific runes to unlock powerful bonus effects. That’ll come in a later update.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/5299ee8c369c313da835bf0e74ae2aab53222e35.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Ranged weapons now support attachments with fifty two effects and counting. Stronger weapons have more slots, and some attachments can get pretty wild. For example, one high end scope locks onto up to eight targets, letting you deal bonus damage to all of them at once.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/f013d6a23b8d1e1be2c62913aeb374397d019319.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also introduced some new threats. Meet the Iron Juggernaut, a massive dual cannon beast inspired by classic heavy hitters. It’s slow, but tanky and deadly. Defeat it and you’ll unlock a new skill called Frost Nova. Another new enemy is the Exploder Zombie. It starts off slow, but once it’s badly hurt, it charges at you and explodes. Definitely one to keep your distance from.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also expanded the skill pool. Some of the new abilities include Attack Drones, Poison Nova inspired by Diablo Two, Celestial Bolt for extra undead damage, Rocket Boost for jetpack jumps and knockbacks, and Blade Dancer, which surrounds you with a swarm of slicing blades.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/094539a91c5110f4bfa3777db7788ce93d5f899a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're still self publishing this game and putting everything we’ve got into it. Thanks so much for sticking with us. More updates are coming soon, so stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Mirari[/p]

notes.title: Dark Light: Survivor Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi Dark Hunters,

Welcome to our very first update for Dark Light: Survivor!

We’re super excited to finally share what we’ve been working on. 
As a small indie team, this game is a labor of love, and we can’t wait to bring you along on this journey. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s happening behind the scenes:

On the programming and animation side, we’ve been busy getting things just right. We’ve recently completed some cool new animations and added a brand-new melee weapon. To make it all feel smooth and satisfying, we’ve spent time tweaking the animations to ensure the gameplay looks polished. 

Our current focus is on enhancing the weapon system, especially for ranged weapons. 
We’re introducing deep customization, so you’ll be able to swap out attachments like handgrips, scopes, handles, ammo, and lasers. Depending on the weapon’s grade, there will be 4-8 interchangeable parts, allowing you to build a setup that fits your style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/cafe7d54336615ecdf6220fa7c21f4237f85b5e7.png[/img]

You might notice that the game has a pixelated look. This is something we’ve designed intentionally to give it that nostalgic old-school gaming vibe we love so much. But if you prefer something different, no worries! We’ve included the option to switch seamlessly between cinematic mode and pixel mode whenever you like—so you get the best of both worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/e2bd30358d15837b3b9d9e9db0b3adf540bf1842.jpg[/img]

On the art and design front, we’ve been working on maps that immerse you in the game’s multiverse setting. The first new map we’re unveiling is the Void Supermarket, a haunting interior map with plenty of atmosphere. We’re also starting on a snow tundra base map set in a post-apocalyptic world. If you have ideas for new maps or environments you’d like to see, let us know in the comments—we’re always open to inspiration from our community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/80578ba525e60303b4d6084e23dba43487aed72d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/3a15380cd883fb7a029147499d892864f446e720.jpg[/img]

We’re also diving into armor and helmet designs. These designs reflect the multiverse theme, blending different eras and styles into unique character looks. Imagine a hero in medieval armor mixed with WWII elements, or a futuristic knight carrying both ancient swords and high-tech gadgets. The enemies will be just as diverse, ranging from cyber-gargoyles to tech-enhanced knights. This mix of past and future will make gameplay fresh and unpredictable, with each realm offering new challenges to overcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119908/c126804b7214cbde39ede78c1d4669307708a5f5.jpg[/img]

As this is our first update, we want to thank you for being here and supporting us from the start. We’re just getting started, and your enthusiasm and feedback mean everything to us. If you want to help us out, you can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Miraricogames]X (Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@darklight7535]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@darklightdev?_t=ZS-8rfzkzTLSjf&_r=1]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/miraricogames.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url] to stay updated on all our progress. Sharing our posts and updates helps us reach more players, and we’ll be posting regularly with new designs and gameplay updates.

Thank you for joining us on this adventure. We’re thrilled to share more as we go, and we’d love to hear your thoughts in the comments below. Let’s make Dark Light: Survivor an incredible experience together. See you in the multiverse!
